factor: bounded fitting support plus saved-primary-relative diagnostics
source_basis: Exact actual m3 runner, byte-identical to bounded R2 runner; only shared external-packet validation and screen budget scope revised.
objective: Existing all-class MacroF1; ranking, models, HPO, refit, evaluator and CSV settings unchanged

resource_meaning.fitting_materialization: At most200000 selected labels and uint64 hashes; streaming generators, one uint64 to64bitmask map, no N-sized Python list or per-class hash sets. Full inherited train loading is unchanged.
resource_meaning.overhead: Support construction, hashes, lineage rereads, copies, serialization, receipts and failures consume the existing task/common wall and memory. Per-context5s/64MiB checks are cooperative; the future owned-parent hard timeout/memory guard remains mandatory. No measured RSS/time savings claimed.
resource_meaning.preparation_budget_scope: prepare_generation_pair accepts an optional same PreparationBudget used before screen for support and capture. If omitted, local receipt explicitly covers only screen entry onward. Earlier support/capture still belongs to the same future30s parent/600s clock; no free5s reset or inferred IO charge.
resource_meaning.future_preparation_parent_enforcement: The future harness must independently own/enforce30s/512MiB/1thread and account support/capture/hashes/rechecks/serialization/receipts/failed preparation. Shared5s/64MiB helper checks are cooperative and do not replace the parent.

rejection.behavior: Reject complete pair before either call for any row/class/label/packet/message/IO/time/JSON overflow; no trimming classes or metrics. Keep failure receipt, do not retry under a larger cap.

lineage.required: Exact primary split.npz fileSHA plus split.json byteSHA and semanticSHA; control JSON byteSHA+semantic recipe signature; each record/job/result/spec/recipe/full_fit=False/direct experiment path/CSV/proba SHA; complete finite per-class F1 and matching all-class mean.
lineage.failures: Missing/failed/wrong-split/fullfit/changed/incomplete metrics yield null comparison with reason. Overflow rejects whole context. No caller bool certifies provenance.
lineage.limits: Byte lineage is not independent rescoring. No npz array decoding or pristine-label metric recomputation occurs here. Source producer/ordered split arrays and independent saved-artifact verification must be bound by the later harness.

matched_generation.shared_preflight: Both complete SYSTEM+STAGED contexts pass the same JSON/class/label/row/message/packet/preparation/resource constraints before either API call. All added ON fields removed reproduce OFF exactly. No arm marker/prompt edits.
matched_generation.common_accounting: 30s shared preparation including all prior support/capture +240s maximum logical requests +330s setup/audit/cleanup reserve=600s; actual total remains authoritative. No reset or borrowed old time.
freeze_before_first_call: Actual current T7 exec65008/source733 terminal plus fresh exact owned/bootstrap/preparer closure and canonical lock proof; older T6 closure is insufficient.
Five pristine input fileSHAs; spec/class/feature order; original feature-hash vector and producer SHA
Single post-primary snapshot chosen before generation quality; exact control plus other primary; no confirmation/HPO outcomes
Primary split.npz SHA and ordered train/validation dtype/shape/arraySHA plus producer
Each primary job/result/CSV/proba SHA; protected control artifactSHA+semantic signature
Exact saved baseline context, derived ON context, both SYSTEM+STAGED message SHAs; same saved remaining metadata and call configuration
matched_generation.outcomes: Keep raw/parsed candidates, duplicate/invalid/null/timeouts, attempts, usage, source/context SHAs and costs. Stochastic generation unless provider actually supports a pinned shared seed. No MacroF1 gain or promotion from generation.
matched_generation.token_accounting: 8192 is per HTTP attempt, not aggregate per logical call. Retry usage may be unavailable; preserve unknown usage, never impute zero. No new aggregate provider-token budget is invented.
matched_generation.timeout_accounting: 120s is one logical request window shared by all existing retry attempts; it is not3*120s.

repair: Exact native type/cardinality checks of10-field support, K-count maps and <=K class lists before support sum/set/any, bounded JSON before packet copy; one validator shared by screen/helper. Valid packet view construction unchanged.
